messages:
Priya (CS): Hey team, Loomacorp just escalated — after yesterday's model rollout they started seeing intermittent 403s on /v1/generate and big latency spikes (~3-5s token latency) during checkout flows. They also report model output changed: line items are truncated and several prices replaced with "N/A". Can eng/ML triage?
Daniel (Eng): Sorry to hear that. Any request_ids or sample payloads from them? 403 + latency together sounds like an auth/token expiry hitting a retry path?
Priya (CS): They've attached a few failing request_ids and one example prompt in the support ticket: request_id=rc_2023248, rc_2023254. Customer says it started right after v2.4.0 rollout.
support-bot: Note: customer has shared logs via support portal (loomacorp-2024-07-12). Use `support-download loomacorp-2024-07-12` to fetch.
Marco (ML): Quick thought — truncation + "N/A" replacements could be a new post-processing step or a safety/formatting regression. Can you paste a minimal prompt that triggers the behavior? Also, did they switch models or set `max_tokens`/`truncate` flags?
Priya (CS): Minimal failing prompt from ticket (redacted):
```
Customer order:
- item: Wireless Mouse x1 $25.00
- item: Keyboard x1 $45.00
Please return a JSON list of items with name, qty, price.
```
Response (customer): `[{"name":"Wireless Mouse","qty":1,"price":"N/A"},{"name":"Keyboard","qty":1,"price":"N/A"}]`
Priya (CS): They say the exact same prompt returned correct prices before rollout. They sent curl they used: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"model":"redwood-v2","prompt":"<above>","max_tokens":256}'`
Daniel (Eng): Thanks — can you ask them to run the call with `X-Request-Id` header and include `X-Debug-Mode: prompt-logs` so we can map tokenization? Example for them: 
```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "X-Request-Id: LOOMA-REPRO-1" \
  -H "X-Debug-Mode: prompt-logs" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2","prompt":"<minimal prompt>","max_tokens":256}'
```
Marco (ML): Also request a small reproducible example with `temperature:0` and content-type JSON. If we see deterministic `N/A` tokens at same offsets we can check code paths for formatting/post-processing.
Aria (SRE): I'll look at latency/403 traces for those request_ids. If the token-level processing is delayed and auth rejects on retry we might see double-counted billing. Priya — please confirm whether the customer observed any sudden spike in usage/billing.
Priya (CS): They reported a one-off billing spike on July 12 (approx +1.2k tokens) that they think is related to those retries. CTO is sensitive.
Daniel (Eng): Action items: 1) Priya ask customer to run the curl with X-Request-Id and X-Debug-Mode, 2) attach the exact response bodies (including headers), 3) confirm model/version used (e.g., redwood-v2@2024-07-11), and 4) whether they set any output filters/formatters in client.
Marco (ML): I'll start a quick diff between v2.3 and v2.4 post-processing steps — focus on token replacement rules and price extraction regexes. If customer can produce the minimal example we'll try to reproduce in staging.
Priya (CS): Shared repro instructions with Loomacorp and asked for the debug call + sample responses. I also gave them a temporary support token to re-run safely. They replied they'll run it in the next 90 minutes and share logs. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Aria (SRE): Noted. I'll pin the request_ids and watch the ingress logs, auth service errors, and retry churn. If we see retries causing extra billing we'll prepare a credit.
Daniel (Eng): If they can't reproduce, ask for earliest timestamp when correct behavior was seen — we may need to roll forward a canary or disable the new formatting.
Priya (CS): Will do. Thanks team — will post their debug payloads here when they come in. :thumbsup:
